name: brand-morph-timeline
description: 品牌标识变形过渡动画编排器
tagline: Morph Your Brand, Frame by Frame.
interaction: Users arrange brand identity elements (logos, colors, typography) along a draggable timeline, defining keyframes where each element morphs into its next state. Scrubbing the playhead or scrolling triggers fluid shape/color transitions in real-time, allowing designers to orchestrate and preview how a brand evolves visually across campaigns or rebrands.
